labels: Raise up and out into a Y

text.setup: Stand tall with very light bells, arms hanging in front of you, thumbs pointing up.
cues: Raise your arms up and out at about 30° from your sides, making a Y.
Pull your shoulder blades down and back as the arms rise.
Lower slowly — the lowering is half the work.
mistakes: Too heavy, so the shoulders shrug and the back arches.
Raising the arms straight to the front instead of out into a Y.

variants.cable: Two low pulleys, crossing the cables, keep tension at the bottom.
variants.resistance_band: Stand on the band; a light one is plenty.
